clips.name: snap-fire-innocent
clips.review: Original had mouth and pupils during upward glance. Local lower-face video retouch removes mouth and fills eye holes. Corrected facial transition sheets inspected. Snap precedes fire; boot extinguishes fire; hands behind back and skyward glance follow. No clipping.
clips.notes: Generated flame casts broad local warm light; effects need separate matte treatment during future sprite integration.
